verdicts.why: MCU Wiki: after the Battle at the Triskelion Barnes 'deserted Hydra' (Winter Soldier), and T'Challa grants him asylum in Wakanda in Civil War, where he goes into cryostasis.
He leaves HYDRA in The Winter Soldier, so the departure is there; in Civil War he goes from no group to Wakanda.

MCU Wiki: Clint retires from the Avengers at the end of Age of Ultron, Steve recruits him out of retirement in Civil War, and after the Raft he 'officially retires from the Avengers'. His first step (Black Widow, Budapest) already has him as a S.H.I.E.L.D. agent.
Carol leaves the Kree/Starforce in Captain Marvel; in the mid-credits scene she only answers Fury's pager and has no group to leave, so the second Independent and left are empty.
Marvel Database files this Beast as Henry McCoy (Earth-TRN1225), Reality = Earth-TRN1225.
Marvel Database files Binary as Maria Rambeau (Earth-TRN1225), an ally of that reality's X-Men.
MCU Wiki: Raynor is a former U.S. Army officer who was discharged before the series; Army is listed as 'formerly' and only backstory. In the show she is Bucky's therapist.
Marvel Database files him as Harvey Elder (Earth-828); First Steps is set on Earth-828, as the twin A:harvey-elder already says.
Marvel Database files Defender Strange as Stephen Strange (Earth-TRN953), Reality = Earth-TRN953 (the MCU Wiki's Earth-617).
MCU Wiki infobox: affiliation Masters of the Mystic Arts (Earth-617); he is his world's Sorcerer Supreme in Multiverse of Madness.
Marvel Database files her as Mary Puppins (Earth-TRN872); Earth-TRN872 is its designation for those pruned to the Void with no known home reality.
MCU Wiki: in Thor's end-credits scene Fury shows Selvig the Tesseract and he accepts, joining S.H.I.E.L.D.'s Project P.E.G.A.S.U.S.
Ross's Air Force service is backstory ('former Air Force pilot, now CIA' in Black Panther); he is CIA from his first title, Civil War.
MCU Wiki: when the Ta Lo elders refuse Wenwu, Ying Li leaves Ta Lo and gives up her powers to live with him. Two stages need a title, so Ta Lo at Shang-Chi fits the data's form.
Wikipedia episode 9 summary: released from DODC custody, she 'loses her job at GLK&H', then after K.E.V.I.N. rewrites the finale she is 'regaining her job'. MCU Wiki: 'fired from GLK&H'.

MCU Wiki lists Agatha's coven as 'formerly': in the Green Witch trial she renounces Agatha, regains her powers, leaves the Road and flies off alone (episode 8). Joining the coven had already moved her from Kale Kare in the data, and nothing returns her to it.
MCU Wiki: after the Marvels split, Kamala uses S.A.B.E.R. files to assemble a team of young heroes, beginning with Kate Bishop, who agrees (The Marvels).
MCU Wiki and Marvel Database (Mel (O.X.E.) (Earth-199999)) give O.X.E. Group as her only affiliation; she is de Fontaine's assistant at O.X.E. No source puts her in the CIA.
MCU Wiki: after the Blip May is an active member of the Salvation Army helping Blip victims and runs the June 2024 shelter fundraiser (Far From Home), then helps at F.E.A.S.T. (No Way Home).
MCU Wiki lists the Marvels among Monica's affiliations; she, Carol and Kamala form the team in The Marvels.
Marvel Database files him as Wade Wilson (Nicepool) (Earth-TRN872), its designation for those pruned to the Void with no known home reality.
Marvel Database files her as Shalla-Bal (Earth-828); the hero twin A:shalla-bal already has Earth-828.

Marvel Database: alias 'The Herald', affiliation 'Formerly: Galactus'; she turns on him and pushes him through the portal in First Steps. But '(from the start)' is only for a single group, so with two stages the herald stage takes the title.

MCU Wiki: helping Steve in Civil War makes her go on the run, branded an enemy of the state and cut off from the intelligence community. In FATWS episode 6 she is pardoned and given back her old CIA post.

On screen in Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S2 she really holds a HYDRA post, as HYDRA's head of security undercover for S.H.I.E.L.D. (MCU Wiki: 'formerly, undercover'). The data records undercover service the same way for Simmons, and the S2 end state is the same, so this is a matter of definition and the record stays.

MCU Wiki: in Luke Cage S2 (episode 4 of the season, LC204) Bobby learns he is a kidney match for his daughter, says goodbye to Luke at the shop and leaves Harlem for San Diego. '(from the start)' is only for a single group, so the barbershop stage takes his first title.
MCU Wiki: in Iron Fist S2 Colleen has stopped fighting and volunteers at the Bayard Community Center, and tells Danny she closed down the dojo. Bayard is listed as an affiliation.
In the S7 finale, after the Chronicoms are beaten, Simmons retires with Fitz to raise Alya. The MCU Wiki lists S.H.I.E.L.D. as 'formerly', and her last step is already 'Retired'.
MCU Wiki: after blackmailing Chao and Benowitz with Malcolm's help, Jeri starts Hogarth & Associates, working from home and meeting Pryce Cheng and Malcolm, in Jessica Jones S2 episode 13 (JJ213).

MCU Wiki: at the end of S2 May takes time off from S.H.I.E.L.D. with Andrew (the wiki calls it her retirement), and fully returns in S3 after Hunter recruits her. At the end of S5 she leaves with Coulson for Tahiti as the Zephyr goes on without them, then returns under Mack in S6.

MCU Wiki: Trish quits Trish Talk on air and ZCN's Ronald Garcia offers her a reporter job (JJ209), and she does a mock report at ZCN. In S3 episode 1 (JJ301) she has an ARN TV clothing show as cover. ZCN and ARN are both listed.
MCU Wiki (AoS122): after Garrett falls, Mike turns down Skye's offer to join Coulson's team and leaves alone to make amends. He belongs to no group until S2, as the twin T:st-deathlok shows.
MCU Wiki (DDBA208): Mr. Charles recruits Bullseye to replace him, Luke's CIA work is done, and he returns home to Jessica and Danielle. CIA is listed as 'formerly'.
In Endgame, Steve stays in the past with Peggy and, as an old man, hands his shield to Sam. He leaves the Avengers, and no group follows.
Marvel Database files the Deadpool & Wolverine Logan as James Howlett (Earth-TRN1400), Reality = Earth-TRN1400, now displaced to Earth-10005.
